Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and evaluation plan — auth + streaming details

Quick engineering update after the first standup and an initial spike: 

- Auth / token rotation: Proposed approach is OAuth2 client-credential for server-to-server calls + short-lived bearer tokens (15m TTL) for clients. I have a draft flow diagram (hosted: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1draft-auth-flow) and a PoC script that mints short-lived tokens using our KMS. PoC ready by 2026-05-13.
- SDK changes: minimal surface-level changes for token refresh; will expose a refresh hook in the mobile SDK to handle rotation without user impact. PR opened today (PR #423).
- Streaming tests: ran two smoke tests — streaming payloads stable but noticed ~1-2% packet jitter when we push >10 concurrent streams. Action: need Lumen staging gateway logs (Sara/Tom) to diagnose.

Action items assigned (from engineering):
- Rishi: deliver auth PoC + flow diagram (2026-05-13).
- Laura: complete SDK PR review and merge (2026-05-14).
- Sean: coordinate with Lumen infra for staging gateway access and provide sample payloads (2026-05-15).

If Lumen procurement needs anything for the POC billing, loop them in and I’ll provide a usage estimate after we have the streaming numbers.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
